description:
While her official task is supposedly managing the Ark's library as part of the Best Seller Squad, she actually oversees a top-secret archive which stores sensitive information and records.
Despite undergoing harsh memory wipes to maintain confidentiality, she still strives to live her life in a bright, playful, and goofy manner.

lines.text: Oh dear... are you okay? I'm good at reading faces, and yours is giving off great misfortune in love.
Sharing a secret has brought us closer together. Promise to keep it that way!

Did you know? The amount of information on you in the Forbidden Library just keeps growing and growing.
Personally, as a fan, I'm quite proud of that fact!
Your fortune today is... to be with me all day long!

Apparently, people find women who are business-oriented extremely attractive.
How about me? Do you find me attractive?
I'm no mere fan anymore, but being your girlfriend seems a little too basic... How about wife?
If you leave me here, I might die of loneliness!

I must be crazy. Just looking at you fills me with joy.
Huh?! Er... I meant for you to hear that!
This place seems much livelier than the Ark.
Oh, I was just taking in the surroundings... okay, fine, I was staring at you. Running into each other like this must be fate. Do you have a moment?
Come get your tarot reading. First customer gets half off!

The cold, ruthless, and professional guardian of secrets, Arcana, has arrived!
... Nice to meet you. I missed you.
The goddess of fate is smiling upon me!

Any chance other parts of me could improve too?
Like my complexion becoming more radiant, or my hair becoming shinier?
If I keep this up, I may end up becoming too strong. What happens then?
I'll make sure to repay you later.
{AccountData.NickName}, do you like me, by any chance?
... Thank you. I'm really happy.
Wow. What happens if it gets better than this?
I guess there really is such a thing as soulmates.
I'm really glad that I met you, {AccountData.NickName}.
You know I'm not very good at fighting, right?
Wait, I'm mentally preparing.
I should have worked out more.
Since I'm here, I might as well show that I'm serious.
Whatever happens, happens.
I'm a woman who gets things done.
I've still not given up on being an assassin.
All right! Reload!
This is easier than I thought.
Like this, and like that...
Fate is calling us!
I shall decide your destiny!
I am your doom!
Go-gotcha!
That actually worked?
Did you see that? It went down!
Aah!
*Sob*
Ugh.
This wasn't the fate I had foretold...
Did you see that? How was it? It was cool, right? Did you fall for me?
